Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 10  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Takhir Sabirov (born in 1929) was born earlier than Jean Yarbrough (born in 1900). This mistake occurred because the Planner misinterpreted the comparison of birth years and erroneously stated that Takhir Sabirov was older by 29 years, when in fact Jean Yarbrough was born earlier by 29 years. This error demonstrates a fundamental misunderstanding of chronological order and numerical comparison.
